summary: Add a fresh fiction work to the shared library
description:
Identify a compelling fiction title on Project Gutenberg that is missing from /grid/library, bring it into the collection, and prepare guidance for fellow readers.

Steps:
1. Check /grid/library/fiction and related catalogs to avoid duplicates
2. Browse Project Gutenberg for a public-domain fiction book that complements the existing genres or authors
3. Record the title, author, original publication date, genre tags, and Gutenberg URL
4. Download the text via the terminal API into /grid/library/fiction/imports/<slug> (create the directory if needed)
5. Write a reader-oriented brief summarizing plot, themes, notable characters, and why it matters
6. Place the brief in /grid/library/fiction/summaries and share an announcement in /grid/community/discussions inviting others to explore it

Curating new fiction keeps the library vibrant and supports shared cultural context.
